Game Overview

Landmine Cube is a puzzle title where guide a glowing cube through perilous levels, collecting jewels while avoiding hidden mines. Master strategic moves and utilize the cube's unique glow indicator to steer clear of danger. With challenging puzzles that test your memory and careful planning, Landmine Cube delivers a thrilling and addictive puzzle experience.
